testCases.title: Search with a valid keyword
preconditions: User is logged into the application.
Products are available in the system.
steps: Navigate to the product search page.
Enter a valid search keyword into the search field.
expectedResults: The system displays a list of products matching the search keyword.

testCases.title: Search with an invalid keyword
preconditions: User is logged into the application.
steps: Navigate to the product search page.
Enter a search keyword that does not match any products.
expectedResults: The system displays an empty result message.
